name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 ジム・コマンド（宇宙戦仕様）

series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム 0080 ポケットの中の戦争
series.en: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080 War in the Pocket

brands.ja: MG [マスターグレード]／プレバンガンプラ

description.ja: コ ロ ニ ー の 守 護 者―マスターグレードシリーズでロールアウト！
description.en: Colony Guardian - Roll out with the Master Grade Series!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 0080 ポケットの中の戦争』から、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam 0080 War in the Pocket",

description.ja: ＲＧＭ－７９ＧＳ ジム・コマンド（宇宙戦仕様）をマスターグレードシリーズで商品化。
description.en: RGM-79GS GM Command (space battle specification) is commercialized in the Master Grade series.

description.ja: ランドセル・頭部・胸部装甲等をはじめとした機体形状を、各所新規造形で徹底再現！ビーム・ガンも新たに付属！
description.en: The shape of the aircraft, including the school bag, head, chest armor, etc., has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling in various parts! A new beam gun is also included!

description.ja: ● ＭＧ準拠の新規造形で、機体形状を再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the aircraft shape with new MG-compliant modeling!

description.ja: 頭部、胸部装甲、ランドセル等、特徴的な機体形状を新規造形で徹底再現。
description.en: The characteristic body shape, such as the head, chest armor, and school bag, has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 【頭部】
description.en: [head]

description.ja: 頬部分にダクトを備えた、拠点防衛型の機体に特徴的な頭部形状を再現。
description.en: Reproduces the characteristic head shape of a base defense type aircraft with ducts on the cheeks.

description.ja: 【胸部】
description.en: [Chest]

description.ja: 胸部装甲部分にダクトが増設された形状を再現。特徴的な赤のカラーは成形色で再現。
description.en: Reproduces the shape with an additional duct added to the chest armor part. The characteristic red color is reproduced with molded color.

description.ja: 【腕部】
description.en: [Arm]

description.ja: 前腕部外装、とヒジ部分の外装は新規パーツ。
description.en: The forearm exterior and elbow exterior are new parts.

description.ja: 【ランドセル】
description.en: [school bag]

description.ja: 先行量産型ジムと比べ、１３０％に相当する推力を有する、バーニアが増設されたランドセルを新規造形で再現。
description.en: Compared to the previous mass-produced gym, the school bag with an added vernier has a thrust equivalent to 130%, and is reproduced with a new model.

description.ja: 【腰部】
description.en: [waist]

description.ja: 中央部分・フロントスカート部分の形状を再現。
description.en: Reproduce the shape of the center part and front skirt part.

description.ja: 【脚部】
description.en: [leg]

description.ja: すね部分の前側装甲は新規パーツで再現。
description.en: The front armor of the shin part is reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: ● ＭＧジム・スナイパーIIをベースとした、可動機構を搭載！
description.en: ● Equipped with a movable mechanism based on MG Jim Sniper II!

description.ja: 【BODY】前後のスイング機構と腰部の回転がもたらす“ひねり”の動きにより、人体に近い可動を実現。
description.en: [BODY] The front and back swing mechanism and the "twisting" movement caused by the rotation of the waist achieve movement similar to that of the human body.

description.ja: 【NECK】首関節は取り付け基部が可動し、射撃ポーズ時の動きに対応。
description.en: [NECK] The attachment base of the neck joint is movable and corresponds to movement during shooting poses.

description.ja: 【SHOULDERS】肩関節に引出しと回転の可動軸を設けることで、多様なアクションに対応。
description.en: [SHOULDERS] A movable axis of drawer and rotation is provided in the shoulder joint to support a variety of actions.

description.ja: 【LEGS＆FEET】脚部フレームは、広範囲な可動を実現。足裏は分割構造により高い接地性を追求。
description.en: [LEGS & FEET] The leg frame allows a wide range of movement. The sole of the foot has a split structure to achieve high ground contact.

description.ja: ● 専用武装 ビーム・ガンを新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the special armament beam gun with new modeling!

description.ja: コロニーでの短時間の防御戦闘を想定した機体にあわせ、火力が強化された専用装備 ビーム・ガンを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The beam gun, a special equipment with enhanced firepower, has been recreated with a new model to suit the aircraft, which is designed for short-term defensive battles in colonies.

description.ja: そのほかにも、多彩な武器類が付属！
description.en: In addition, various weapons are included!

description.ja: ● 新規デザインの水転写式デカール付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!

description.ja: 地球連邦軍のマーキングに加えて、サウス・バニング率いる”不死身の第４小隊”の部隊マーク、
description.en: In addition to the markings of the Earth Federation army, the unit markings of the "Immortal 4th Platoon" led by South Banning,

description.ja: 及び第４小隊４名のパーソナルマークを収録。
description.en: Also includes the personal marks of four members of the 4th Platoon.

description.ja: ＡＣＥ ＰＩＬＯＴ ＬＯＧ　エース・パイロットログ[Ｕ.Ｃ.編]
description.en: ACE PILOT LOG Ace Pilot Log [U.C. edition]

description.ja: “エース・パイロット”とＭＳが、宇宙世紀の歴史に刻んだ”ログ（記録）”をたどる、ＷＥＢ企画！
description.en: A web project in which “Ace Pilot” and MS trace the “logs” carved into the history of the Universal Century!

description.ja: ＶＯＬ.０３“不死身の第４小隊”掲載！
description.en: VOL.03 “Immortal 4th Platoon” published!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ビーム・ガン　／　ブルバップ・マシンガン　／　ビーム・サーベル　／ シールド
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam gun / Bullbop machine gun / Beam saber / Seal
